content: Most previous work on context-aware NMT assumed that either all the bilingual data is available at the document level BIBREF2, BIBREF3, BIBREF4, BIBREF5, BIBREF6, BIBREF7, BIBREF8, BIBREF9, BIBREF10 or at least its fraction BIBREF11. But in practical scenarios, document-level parallel data is often scarce, which is one of the challenges when building a context-aware system.
